desc: Read input: N, K, and the tree edges. Build adjacency list and compute parent pointers and depths using BFS/DFS from node 1.
Create a list of all nodes sorted by depth in descending order.
Initialize a `covered` array to keep track of visited nodes.
Iterate through the sorted nodes: if a node is not covered, attempt to form a path of length K by moving up K-1 times via parent pointers.
During the path formation, if any node is already covered or we run out of ancestors (parent is None), output "No" and exit.
If the path is successfully formed, mark all K nodes as covered. After processing all nodes, if all nodes are covered, output "Yes".
